peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
mainyô spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum kat tâ nara irista aêsha
druxsh ýâ nasush upa- dvãsaiti.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Ahura Mazda, most beneficent
Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When a man
dies, at what moment does the Druj Nasu rush upon him?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，最慈悲的善靈，物質世界的造主，持阿沙的聖者啊！當人死亡時，德魯格‧納蘇會在何時衝向他？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ishare pasca para-iristîm
spitama zarathushtra us haca baodhô ayât aêsha
druxsh ýâ nasush upa-dvãsaiti apâxedhraêibyô
naêmaêibyô maxshi kehrpa erekhaitya frashnaosh
apazadhanghô akaranem driwyå ýatha zôizhdishtâish
xrafstrâish.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Directly after death, as soon as the
soul has left the body, O Spitama Zarathushtra! the Druj Nasu
comes and rushes upon him, from the regions of the north, in the
shape of a raging fly, with knees and tail sticking out, droning
without end, and like unto the foulest Khrafstras.
[3. 'On him she stays until the dog has seen the
corpse or eaten it up, or until the flesh-eating birds
have taken flight towards it. When the dog has seen it or eaten it up, or when the flesh-eating
birds have taken flight towards it, then the Druj Nasu rushes
away to the regions of the north in the shape of a raging fly,
with knees and tail sticking out, droning without end, and like
unto the foulest Khrafstras.']
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『死亡直後，靈魂剛離開身體時，
斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！德魯格‧納蘇
就會來臨，從北方的諸地域衝向他，形如
狂暴的蒼蠅，膝蓋與尾巴突出，嗡嗡
無盡地鳴叫，如同最污穢的克拉弗斯特拉。
〔3.『她停駐在他身上，直到狗看見他為止
屍體或吃掉它，或直到食肉鳥類
飛向它。當狗看見它或吃掉它，或當食肉
鳥類飛向它時，則德魯格‧納蘇倉促
逃往北方區域，形如一隻狂暴的蒼蠅，
膝蓋和尾巴突出，嗡嗡聲永不休止，並如同
最污穢的克拉弗斯特拉。']

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If the man has
been killed by a dog, or by a wolf, or by witchcraft, or by the
artifices of hatred, or by falling down a precipice, or by the
law, or by calumny, or by the noose,
how long after death does the Druj Nasu come and rush upon the dead?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若此人已被狗所殺，或被狼所殺，或被巫術所殺，或被仇恨之謀計所殺，或被從絕壁墜落所殺，或被法律所殺，或被誹謗所殺，或被絞刑所殺，那麼在死後多久時間，德魯格‧納蘇會來臨並衝向死者？

segments.orig:

... ýezi puxdhem frâshnaoiti tûirîm paiti-raêthwayeiti,
aêtadha aêtahe âste stairishca barezishca hãm-

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'At the next watch after death, the Druj
Nasu comes and rushes upon the dead, from the regions of the north,
in the shape of a raging fly, with knees and tail sticking out,
droning without end, and like unto the foulest Khrafstras.'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If there be a
number of men resting in the same place, on the same carpet, on
the same pillows, be there two men near one another, or five,
or fifty, or a hundred, close by one another; and of those people
one happens to die; how many of them does the Druj Nasu envelope
with corruption, infection, and pollution?
Ahura Mazda answered:
'If the dead one be a priest, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the eleventh and defiles the
ten.
'If the dead one he a warrior, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the tenth and defiles the nine.
'If the dead one be a husbandman, the Druj Nasu rushes forth,
O Spitama Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the ninth and defiles
the eight.
'If it be a shepherd's dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! she goes as far as the eighth and defiles the seven.
'If it be a house dog, the Druj Nasu rushes forth, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
she goes as far as the seventh and defiles the six.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『死後次一時刻，德魯格‧納蘇
從北方的諸地區而來，衝撲向屍體，
形如狂怒的蒼蠅，膝蓋和尾巴突出，
無盡地嗡鳴，如最污穢的赫拉夫斯特拉。』
「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若有一
群男人棲息於同一處所、同一地毯、同一
枕上，或二人彼此近在咫尺，或五人，
或五十人，或一百人，彼此密集在一起；而在這些人中
其一碰巧死去；德魯格‧納蘇有多少人為
腐敗、感染和污穢所籠罩？」
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：
「若死者為祭司，德魯格‧納蘇衝撲出去，斯皮塔瑪
查拉圖斯特拉啊！她達到第十一人，並玷污第
十人。」
「若死者為戰士，德魯格‧納蘇衝撲出去，斯皮塔瑪
查拉圖斯特拉啊！她達到第十人，並玷污第九人。」
「若死者為農人，德魯格‧納蘇衝撲出去，
斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉啊！她達到第九人，並玷污第
八人。」
「若為牧羊犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝撲出去，斯皮塔瑪
查拉圖斯特拉啊！她達到第八人，並玷污第七人。」
「若為家犬，德魯格‧納蘇衝撲出去，斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉啊！
她達到第七人，並玷污第六人。」

segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染他的床舖與枕頭的哪一部分？

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The Druj Nasu defiles with corruption,
infection, and pollution the upper sheet and the inner garment.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染上層床單與內層衣物。」

anghen ashâum zarathushtra, kva aêva, ýezi
anghat upaêtem vâ aiwi-naptîm vâ aiwi-

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can that garment
be made clean, O holy Ahura Mazda! that has been touched by the
carcass of a dog or the corpse of a man?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！被犬的屍體或人的屍體接觸過的那件衣物，哦聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，能被洗淨嗎？

segments.orig:
âat ýezi nôit anghat upaêtem vâ
aiwi-naptîm vâ aiwi-iritîm vâ aiwi-vañtîm

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It can, O holy Zarathushtra!'
How so?
'If there be on the garment seed, or blood, or dirt, or vomit,
the worshippers of Mazda shall rend it to pieces, and bury it
under the ground.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它能被洗淨，哦聖者查拉圖斯特拉！」
何以如此？
「若衣物上有種子、或血液、或污垢、或嘔吐物，馬茲達的信徒應將其撕成碎片，埋在地下。」

segments.orig:
ýezi anghat izaênish thrish frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush thrish zemô hañkanayen
thrish âpô frasnâdhayen thrish månghô
upa-baodhayãn raocanem paiti nmânahe.
segments.en:
'But if there be no seed [on the garment], nor blood, nor
dirt, nor vomit, then the worshippers of Mazda shall wash it with
gomez.
segments.zh: 「但若衣物上無種子〔也無血液、無污垢、無嘔吐物〕，則馬茲達的信徒應用牛尿液洗淨它。」

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat ubdaênish xshvash frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush xshvash zemô hañkanayen
xshvash âpô frasnâdhayen xshvash månghô
upa-baodhayãn raocanem paiti nmânahe.
segments.en:
'If it be leather, they shall wash it with gomez three times,
they shall rub it with earth three times, they shall wash it with
water three times, and afterwards they shall expose it to the
air for three months at the window of the house.
'If it be woven cloth, they shall wash it with gomez six times,
they shall rub it with earth six times, they shall wash it with
water six times, and afterwards they shall expose it to the air
for six months at the window of the house.
segments.zh:
「若為皮革，他們應用牛尿液洗淨三次，用土壤擦拭三次，用水洗淨三次，之後應在房屋的窗邊使其在空氣中暴露三個月。」
「若為織布，他們應用牛尿液洗淨六次，用土壤擦拭六次，用水洗淨六次，之後應在房屋的窗邊使其在空氣中暴露六個月。」

segments.en:
'The spring named Ardvi Sura, O Spitama Zarathushtra! that
spring of mine, purifies the seed of males, the womb of females,
the milk of females.'
segments.zh: 「名為阿爾德維‧蘇拉的泉水，哦斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！那泉水，我的泉水，淨化男性的種子、女性的子宮、女性的乳汁。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ vastra hãm-
ýûta ... acishtâi anguhe.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can those clothes,
when once washed and cleansed, ever be used either by a Zaotar,
or by a Havanan, or by an Atare-vakhsha, or by a Frabaretar, or
by an Abered, or by an Asnatar, or by a Rathwiskar, or by a Sraosha-varez,
or by any priest, warrior, or husbandman?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Never can those clothes, even when
washed and cleansed, be used either by a Zaotar, or by a Havanan,
or by an Atare-vakhsha, or by a Frabaretar, or by an Abered, or
by an Asnatar, or by a Rathwiskar, or by a Sraosha-varez, or by
any priest, warrior, or husbandman.
'But if there be in a Mazdean house a woman who is in her
sickness, or a man who has become unfit for work, and who must
sit in the place of infirmity, those clothes shall serve for their
coverings and for their sheets, until they can withdraw their
hands for prayer.
'Ahura Mazda, indeed, does not allow us to waste anything
of value that we may have, not even so much as an Asperena's weight
of thread, not even so much as a maid lets fall in spinning.
'Whosoever throws any clothing on a dead body, even so much
as a maid lets fall in spinning, is not a pious man whilst alive,
nor shall he, when dead, have a place in Paradise.
'He makes himself a viaticum unto the world of the wicked,
into that world, made of darkness, the offspring of darkness,
which is Darkness' self. To that world, to the world of Hell,
you are delivered by your own doings, by your own religion, O
sinners!'
 
 IV.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些衣服，一旦被洗滌和潔淨之後，是否還能被任何祭司長、或獻祭者、或火祭司、或祭品分配者、或助祭、或聖火守護者、或誦經者、或斯勞沙使者、或任何祭司、戰士或農民使用？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「那些衣服，即使被洗滌和潔淨之後，也永遠不能被任何祭司長、或獻祭者、或火祭司、或祭品分配者、或助祭、或聖火守護者、或誦經者、或斯勞沙使者、或任何祭司、戰士或農民使用。」
「但若在瑪茲達信徒的家中，有一名婦女正經歷她的經期，或一名男子已變得不適於勞作，必須坐在患病之所，那麼那些衣服應當用作他們的蓋布和床單，直到他們能夠伸出雙手進行祈禱。」
「阿胡拉‧馬茲達實在不允許我們浪費任何有價值的東西，我們可能擁有的任何東西，即使是一根線的阿斯佩雷納重量那麼多，即使是一名女僕在紡織時所掉落的那麼多。」
「無論誰將任何衣服拋在死屍上，即使是一名女僕在紡織時所掉落的那麼多，他在活著的時候就不是虔誠的人，他在死後也不會在天堂裡有位置。」
「他為自己製造了前往惡人之世界的路費，前往那個由黑暗所造、黑暗之後代、黑暗本身的世界。前往那個世界，前往地獄之世界，你們因自己的所作所為、因自己的信仰而被送去，啊眾罪人！」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can he be clean
again who has eaten of the carcass of a dog or of the corpse of
a man?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！曾經吃過死狗或死人屍體的人，能否再次潔淨？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ayaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum zarathushtra, taêca narô geredhô-keretåsca
zeredhô- keretåsca taêca narô spiti-dôithra
cashmanat haca nizhbareñti tê aêshãm
paiti srvê aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush upa-dvãsaiti,
ayaozhdya pascaêta bavaiñti ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He cannot, O holy Zarathushtra! His
burrow shall be dug out, his heart shall be torn out, his bright
eyes shall be put out; the Druj Nasu falls upon him, takes hold
of him even to the end of the nails, and he is unclean thenceforth,
for ever and ever.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他不能，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！他的獸穴應被挖出，他的心應被撕裂，他的明亮眼睛應被熄滅；德魯格‧納蘇落在他身上，握住他直至指甲的盡頭，他自此不潔，永遠永遠不潔。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ nara ýaozhdayãn

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can he be clean
again, O holy Ahura Mazda! who has brought a corpse with filth
into the waters, or unto the fire, and made either unclean?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！持聖潔的阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！誰把屍體連同污穢帶入水中或帶入火中，使其中任一者不潔，他能否再次潔淨？

anghen ashâum zarathushtra,
tê sûnô madhaxayåsca
aogazdastema bavaiñti

aogazdastema bavaiñti
ýôi nasu-kereta drvañtô,

Ahura Mazda answered: 'He cannot, O holy Zarathushtra! Those
wicked ones it is, those Nasu-cutters, that most increase spiders
and locusts; those wicked ones it is, those Nasu-cutters, that
most increase the grass-destroying drought.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『不能，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！那些邪惡的人，那些切割納蘇者，最增長蜘蛛和蝗蟲；那些邪惡的人，那些切割納蘇者，最增長毀壞草木的乾旱。

gaojanô jaiwi-vafrahe
upa-srvatô xrûtahe
akhavatô duzhdånghahe
aogazdastema bavaiñti
ýôi nasu-kereta drvañtô, tê aêshãm

segments.en:
'Those wicked ones it is, those Nasu-cutters, that increase
most the power of the winter, produced by the fiends, the cattle-killing,
thick- snowing, overflowing, the piercing, fierce, mischievous
winter. Upon them comes and rushes the Druj Nasu she takes hold
of them even to the end of the nails, and they are unclean, thenceforth,
for ever and ever.'
segments.zh: 「這些邪惡者，這些納蘇切割者，他們增加得最多的是冬季的力量，由邪靈所產生的、殺害牲畜的、厚重降雪的、氾濫的、刺骨的、兇猛的、惡意的冬季。德魯格‧納蘇來到他們身上，衝向他們，握住他們直至指甲的盡頭，他們自此不潔，永遠永遠不潔。」

O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can the wood
be made clean, O holy Ahura Mazda! whereunto Nasu has been brought

How so?
'If the Nasu has not yet been expelled by the corpse-eating dogs,

ground, all the wood on a Vitasti a all around, if the wood be

segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『能的，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！』如何呢？『若納蘇尚未被食屍狗或食屍鳥驅逐，則他們應將所有木材分開放在地上，若木材乾燥，周圍維塔斯提之距；若木材潮濕，周圍弗拉拉特尼之距；隨後他們應用水灑它一次，它便潔淨。

segments.orig:

naptanãm aêtavat karshtanãm aêtavat

aderetanãm aêtavat hvastanãm aêtavat

is sown or not sown; as it is reaped or not reaped; [as it is

segments.zh: 死者周圍的穀物如此之多，他們應當分別放置於地上，按照穀物之乾燥或濕潤，已種或未種，已收穫或未收穫，〔已脫粒或未脫粒〕，已揚淨或未揚淨，〔已磨粉或未磨粉〕，已揉搓〔或未揉搓〕；他們應當用水灑過一次，如此便潔淨矣。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat aête ýôi
mazdayasna baêshazâi fravazåñte katârô
paurvô âmayåñte mazdayasnaêibyô
vâ daêvayasnaêibyô vâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a worshipper
of Mazda want to practice the art of healing, on whom shall he
first prove his skill? on worshippers of Mazda or on worshippers
of the Daevas?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一位馬茲達信徒欲精習醫道之藝，他應當首先在何人身上試驗其技能？在馬茲達信徒身上或在迭瓦信徒身上？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, daêvayasnaêibyô
paurvô âmayayañta ýatha mazdayasnaêibyascit,
ýat paoirîm daêvayasnô kereñtât
ava hô miryâite ýat bitîm daêvayasnô
kereñtât ava hô miryâite ýat thritîm
daêvayasnô kereñtât ava hô miryâite
anâmâtô zî aêshô ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'On worshippers of the Daevas shall
he first prove himself, rather than on worshippers of Mazda. If
he treat with the knife a worshipper of the Daevas and he die;
if he treat with the knife a second worshipper of the Daevas and
he die; if he treat with the knife for the third time a worshipper
of the Daevas and he die, he is unfit for ever and ever.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他應當首先在迭瓦信徒身上試驗自己，勿如對待馬茲達信徒。若他以刀治療一迭瓦信徒而其人死亡；若他以刀治療第二迭瓦信徒而其人死亡；若他第三次以刀治療一迭瓦信徒而其人死亡，則他永遠永遠不堪從事醫道。

segments.orig:
mâca pascaêta mazdayasna vîmâdhascit
vîmâdhayañta mâca kereñtu mazdayasna
mâca keretu irishyât, ýezi pascaêta mazdayasna
vîmâdhascit vîmâdhayåñte
ýezi kereñte mazdayasna ýezi keretu irishyât
para hê irisheñtô raêshem cikayat baodhô-varshtahe
cithaya.
segments.en:
'Let him therefore never attend any worshipper of Mazda; let
him never treat with the knife and worshipper of Mazda, nor wound
him with the knife. If he shall ever attend any worshipper of
Mazda, if he shall ever treat with the knife any worshipper of
Mazda, and wound him with the knife, he shall pay for his wound
the penalty for willful murder.
segments.zh: 「是故他永不應當侍奉任何馬茲達信徒；他永不應當以刀治療馬茲達信徒，亦不應當以刀傷害之。若他曾侍奉任何馬茲達信徒，若他曾以刀治療馬茲達信徒並以刀傷害之，他應當為其傷人行為支付故意殺人之懲罰。

segments.orig:
ýat paoirîm daêvayasnô kereñtât
apa hô jasât ýat bitîm daêvayasnô
kereñtât apa hô jasât ýat thritîm
daêvayasnô kereñtât apa hô jasât
âmâtô zî aêshô ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
'If he treat with the knife a worshipper of the Daevas and
he recover; if he treat with the knife a second worshipper of
the Daevas and he recover; if for the third time he treat with
the knife a worshipper of the Daevas and he recover; then he is
fit for ever and ever.
segments.zh: 「若他用刀為一位迭瓦的崇拜者施治，而彼得以康復；若他用刀為第二位迭瓦的崇拜者施治，而彼得以康復；若他第三次用刀為一位迭瓦的崇拜者施治，而彼得以康復；則他永遠永遠適合為他人施治。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'He may henceforth at his will attend worshippers of Mazda;
he may at his will treat with the knife worshippers of Mazda,
and heal them with the knife.
 
 VIIb.
segments.zh: 「自此之後，他得依其意願侍奉馬茲達的崇拜者；他得依其意願用刀為馬茲達的崇拜者施治，並以刀療癒他們。」

segments.orig:

âfritôit nmânahe nmânô-paitîm

segments.en:
'A healer shall heal a priest for a blessing of the just;
he shall heal the master of a house for the value of an ox of
low value; he shall heal the lord of a borough for the value of
an ox of average value; he shall heal the lord of a town for the
value of an ox of high value; he shall heal the lord of a province
for the value of a chariot and four.
segments.zh: 「醫者應以正義之福為祭司施治；應以低價值牛的價值為一家之主施治；應以中等價值牛的價值為一鎮之主施治；應以高價值牛的價值為一城之主施治；應以馬車和四匹馬的價值為一省之主施治。」

segments.zh: 「他應以她驢的價值為一家之主的妻子施治；應以母牛的價值為一鎮之主的妻子施治；應以母馬的價值為一城之主的妻子施治；應以母駱駝的價值為一省之主的妻子施治。」

segments.orig:
ýat pouru-baêshaza hañjasåñte
spitama zarathushtra karetô-baêshazêsca urvarô-baêshazêsca
mãthrô-baêshazêsca tem ithra hañjasåñte
ýat mãthrem speñtem baêshazem, aêshô
zî asti baêshazanãm baêshazyôtemô
ýat mãthrem speñtem baêshazyô

segments.en:
'If several healers offer themselves together, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
namely, one who heals with the knife, one who heals with herbs,
and one who heals with the Holy Word [manthra], let one apply to the healing
by the Holy Word: for this one is the best-healing of all healers
who heals with the Holy Word; he will best drive away sickness
from the body of the faithful.'
segments.zh: 「若多位醫者同時出現，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！即一位以刀施治者、一位以草藥施治者，以及一位以聖言施治者，應當使用聖言施治者來施治：因為此人乃所有醫者中最善於療癒者，即以聖言施治者；他將最好地從信徒的身體中驅除疾病。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvañtem drâjô
zrvânem sairi mashya iriste zemê nidhâite raocå
aiwi-varena hvare-daresya zemô bavaiñti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How long after
the corpse of a dead man has been laid down on the ground, clothed
with the light of heaven and beholding the sun, is the ground
clean again?
segments.zh: 「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！死人的屍體被放置在地上，披著天堂的光輝，注視著太陽之後，要多久地面才再度潔淨？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýâre-drâjô
ashâum zarathushtra sairi mashya iriste zemê nidhâite
raocå aiwi-varena hvare-daresya zemô bavaiñti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'When the corpse of a dead man has lain
on the ground for a year, clothed with the light of heaven, and
beholding the sun, then the ground is clean again, O holy Zarathushtra!'
segments.zh: 「阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『當死人的屍體已在地上放置一年，披著天堂的光輝，注視著太陽之後，則地面潔淨，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！』」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvañtem drâjô
zrvânem sairi mashya iriste zemê nikañte havat-zemô
bavaiñti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How long after
the corpse of a dead man has been buried in the earth, is the
earth clean again?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！死人的屍體埋入土中多久之後，土地才會潔淨呢？

segments.orig:

saredhãm spitama zarathushtra sairi mashya iriste zemê
nikañte havat-zemô bavaiñti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'When the corpse of a dead man has lain
buried in the earth for fifty years, O Spitama Zarathushtra! then
the earth is clean again.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『死人的屍體埋入土中五十年之後，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！那時土地才會潔淨。』

segments.orig:

zrvânem sairi mashya iriste daxme nidhâite havat-zemô
bavaiñti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How long after
the corpse of a dead man has been laid down on a Dakhma, is the
ground, whereon the Dakhma stands, clean again?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！死人的屍體被放置在寂靜之塔上多久之後，寂靜之塔所矗立的地面才會潔淨呢？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit nû
para ahmât spitama zarathushtra ýat aêsha pãsnu
raêthwât, haxshaêsha spitama zarathushtra kemcit
anghêush astvatô aêtaêshva daxmaêshva
vî-kañtêe.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Not until the dust of the corpse, O
Spitama Zarathushtra! has mingled with the dust of the earth.
Urge every one in the material world, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
to pull down Dakhmas.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『直到屍體的塵埃，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！與土地的塵埃混合為止。斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！督促物質世界中的每一個人拆毀寂靜之塔。

segments.orig:
ýasca mê aêtaêshãm ýat
daxmanãm avavañtem mazô vîkânayât
ýatha hê tanush anghat patitem hê manô
anghat patitem vacô patitem shyaothnem uzvarshtem hê
manô anghat uzvarshtem vacô uzvarshtem shyaothnem.
segments.en:
'He who should pull down Dakhmas, even so much thereof as
the size of his own body, his sins in thought, word, and deed
are remitted as they would be by a Patet; his sins in thought,
word, and deed are undone.
segments.zh: 『凡是拆毀寂靜之塔者，即使所拆毀的不過是相當於自己身體大小的部分，他的思想、言辭和行為中的罪孽也會被寬恕，如同通過悔禮一樣；他的思想、言辭和行為中的罪孽也會被消除。

segments.orig:
nôit zî ahmi paiti nairi dva mainyû rêna
ava-stånghat, frasha fraya vahishtem â ahûm,
berejayåñti-shê zarathushtra strêshca
månghemca hvareca azemca hê berejaêm ýô
dadhvå ahurô mazdå, ushta itha tê nare
ýô ithyejanghatat haca anghaot aithyejanghem ahûm
â frafrå!
segments.en:
'Not for his soul shall the two spirits wage war with one
another; and when he enters Paradise, the stars, the moon, and
the sun shall rejoice in him; and I, Ahura Mazda, shall rejoice
in him, saying: " Hail, O man! thou who hast just passed
from the decaying world into the undecaying one!"'
segments.zh: 『不會有兩種靈為他的靈魂而互相爭戰；當他進入天堂時，群星、月亮和太陽會為他歡欣；而我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，也會為他歡欣，說道：『祝賀你，人啊！你剛剛從衰敗的世界進入到不衰敗的世界！』』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kva asti daêvô kva
daêvayâzô kva daêvanãm hañdvarenô
kva daêvanãm hãm-patanô kva daêva
hañdvareñti pañcasakhnâi satakhnâishca
satakhnâi hazangrakhnâishca hazangrakhnâi baêvarekhnâishca
baêvarekhnâi ahãshtakhnâishca.

âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtaêshva
daxmaêshva spitama zarathushtra ýôi paiti âya
zemâ bavaiñti uzdaêza uzdishta ýahmya
narô irista nidhayeiñte hâu asti daêvô
hâu daêvayâzô hâu daêvanãm
hañdvarenô hâu daêvanãm hãm-
patanô avat daêva hañdvareñti pañcasakhnâi
satakhnâishca satakhnâi hazangrakhnâishca hazangrakhnâi
baêvarekhnâishca baêvarekhnâi ahãshtakhnâishca.

mãnayen bâ spitama zarathushtra aête ýôi
daêva aêtaêshva daxmaêshva gangheñti
apâca vaêpeñti ýatha aêtahmi anghvô
ýat astvaiñti ýûzhem ýôi
mashyâka hvaretha hvâsta huyâresh gãmca
hvâstem hvaraiti nâuiti hâ aête ýôi
mashyâka hvareñti framanyete.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Where are there
Daevas: Where is it they offer worship to the Daevas: What is
the place whereon troops of Daevas rush together, whereon troops
of Daevas come rushing along? What is the place whereon they rush
together to kill their fifties and their hundreds, their hundreds
and their thousands, their thousands and their tens of thousands,
their tens of thousands and their myriads of myriads?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！迭瓦在哪裡？迭瓦在哪裡獻祭膜拜迭瓦？迭瓦群集之地在哪裡，迭瓦群蜂擁而至之地在哪裡？他們在哪個地方群集在一起殺死五十人及百人，百人及千人，千人及萬人，萬人及千千萬人？

segments.orig:
aêshô zî asti daêvanãm rapakô
vîspem â ahmât ýat aêsha gañtish
upanghacaiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Those Dakhmas that are built upon the
face of the earth, O Spitama Zarathushtra! and whereon are laid
the corpses of dead men, that is the place where there are Daevas,
that is the place whereon troops of Daevas rush together; whereon
troops of Daevas come rushing along; whereon they rush together
to kill their fifties and their hundreds, their hundreds and their
thousands, their thousands and their tens of thousands, their
tens of thousands and their myriads of myriads.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『那些建在地面之上的寂靜之塔，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！死人的屍體被放置其上的地方，那就是迭瓦所在的地方，那就是迭瓦群集之地；迭瓦群蜂擁而至之地；他們在那裡群集在一起殺死五十人及百人，百人及千人，千人及萬人，萬人及千千萬人。'

segments.orig:
aêtaêshva daxmaêshva hãm-bavaiñti
axtishca garenushca tafnushca naêzasca sârastishca
akhôstishca pourushu asti varsô.
segments.en:
'On those Dakhmas, O Spitama Zarathushtra! those Daevas take
food and void filth. As you, men, in the material world, you cook
meal and eat cooked meat, so do they. It is, as it were, the smell
of their feeding that you smell there, O men!
segments.zh: 「在那些寂靜之塔上，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！那些迭瓦取食並排泄污穢。如同你們人類在物質世界中烹飪食物和食用熟肉一樣，他們也這樣做。這好似他們進食時的臭味，你們人類所聞到的，就是那氣味！」

segments.orig:
aêtaêshva daxmaêshva mashya hãm mereñcyãstema
bavaiñti pasca hû frâshmô-dâitîm.
segments.en:
'For thus they go on reveling, until that stench is rooted
in the Dakhmas. In those Dakhmas arise the infection of diseases,
itch, hot fever, naeza, cold fever, rickets, and hair untimely
white. On those Dakhmas meet the worst murderers, from the hour
when the sun is down.
segments.zh: 「因為他們就這樣盡情放縱下去，直到那惡臭紮根於寂靜之塔。在那些寂靜之塔中出現疾病感染、癢症、熱熱、納蛇、冷熱、佝僂症和過早變白的毛髮。在那些寂靜之塔上聚集最兇惡的殺人犯，從太陽下山的時刻起。」

segments.orig:
taêca ýâ kasu-xratush masyô-xrathwãm
nôit paitishaiti thrishum aêtaêshãm axtinãm
jãnayô dreñjaiti aoshtaca paiti dumnaca thrivataca
gaêsush!
segments.en:
'And people of small understanding who do not seek for better
understanding, the Jainis make those diseases
grow stronger by a third, on their thighs, on their hands,
on their three-plaited hair.'
segments.zh: 「而那些理解不足、不尋求更好理解的人民，雅伊尼教徒使這些疾病在他們的大腿上、手上、三股編結的毛髮上增強三倍。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat ahmi nmâne
ýat mâzdayasnôish nâirika upas-puthrîm
jasât ... apâca nava upa makhem paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If in the house
of a worshipper of Mazda there be a woman with child, and if being
a month gone, or two, or three, or four, or five, or six, or seven,
or eight, or nine, or ten months gone, she bring forth a still-born
child, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The place in that Mazdean house whereof
the ground is the cleanest and the driest, and the least passed
through by flocks and herds, by the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the
consecrated bundles of baresma, and by the faithful;'
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! How far from
the fire? How far from the water? How far from the consecrated
bundles of baresma? How far from the faithful?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty paces from the fire; thirty
paces from the water; thirty paces from the consecrated bundles
of Baresma; three paces from the faithful;-
'On that place shall the worshippers of Mazda erect an enclosure,
and therein shall they establish her with food, therein shall
they establish her with clothes.'
O Maker of the material word, thou Holy One! What is the food
that the woman shall first take?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Gomez mixed with ashes, three draughts
of it, or six, or nine, to send down the Dakhma within her womb.
'Afterwards she may drink boiling milk of mares, cows, sheep,
or goats, with pap or without pap; she may take cooked milk without
water, meal without water, and wine without water.' 68. O Maker
of the material world, thou Holy One! How long shall she remain
so? How long shall she live thus on milk, meal, and wine?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Three nights long shall she remain
so; three nights long shall she live thus on milk, meal, and wine.
Then, when three nights have passed, she shall wash her body,
she shall wash her clothes, with gomez and water, by the nine
holes, and thus shall she be clean.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若馬茲達的信徒之家中有一懷孕的婦女，且懷孕一月、或二月、或三月、或四月、或五月、或六月、或七月、或八月、或九月、或十月，她生下一具死胎，馬茲達的信徒應當做什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「在該馬茲達信徒之家中，地面最潔淨、最乾燥、且最少被牲畜經過、被阿胡拉‧馬茲達之火經過、被已祝聖的麥稈束經過、被信徒經過的地方；」
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！距離火多遠？距離水多遠？距離已祝聖的麥稈束多遠？距離信徒多遠？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「距離火三十步；距離水三十步；距離已祝聖的麥稈束三十步；距離信徒三步；」
「馬茲達的信徒應在該地方豎立一道圍欄，在其中應為她設置食物，在其中應為她設置衣物。」
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！婦女應當首先進食什麼食物？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以灰混合的贈禮液，其中三口或六口或九口，以便將寂靜之塔送入她的子宮中。」
「之後她可以飲用馬、牛、羊或山羊的沸騰乳汁，加粥或不加粥；她可以服用不加水的煮乳，不加水的麥粉，以及不加水的葡萄酒。」
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！她應當如此存留多久？她應當如此靠乳、麥粉和葡萄酒存活多久？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「她應當如此存留三晚；她應當如此靠乳、麥粉和葡萄酒存活三晚。於是，三晚過後，她應當用贈禮液和水從九個孔口洗淨她的身體，她應當洗淨她的衣物，如此她便潔淨了。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezica hê hãm
tafnô jasât avi tanuye zôishnuye ýezica
hê dva ýaska avi acishtô âjasât
ýasca shudhô ýasca tarshnô hvarât
aêsha nâirika âpem.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! But if fever
befall her unclean body, if these two worst pains, hunger and
thirst, befall her, may she be allowed to drink water?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！但若熱病降臨於她不潔的身體，若這兩樣最大的苦痛——飢餓與口渴——降臨於她，是否允許她飲水？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hvarât avat
hê asti masyô arethem ýat ushtânem buñjayât
para kahmâicit dahmanãm dahmâhu vaêthâhu
dahmaca ashavanasca, adha aêsha nâirika zastô-maiti
âpem franguharât, âat vô ýûzhem
ýôi mazdayasna cithãm frâthweresaêta
aoxtô ratush aoxtô sraoshâvarezô cithãm
frâthweresaiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'She may; the first thing for her is
to have her life saved. From the hands of one of the holy men,
a holy faithful man, who knows the holy knowledge, she shall drink
of the strength-giving water. But you, worshippers of Mazda, fix
ye the penalty for it. The Ratu being applied to, the Sraosha-varez
being applied to, shall prescribe the penalty to be paid.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「允許；對她而言，首要之事是拯救其生命。她應當從聖人之中某位——一位聖潔、忠信、懂得聖知的人的手中飲用賦力的水。但你們，馬茲達的信徒啊，應當制訂此事的罰則。拉圖被召喚，斯勞沙鞭被召喚，應當規定要支付的罰則。」

segments.orig:
kâ-hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, aêtahe paiti peshô-tanuye duye saite
upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya duye
saite sraoshô-caranaya!
segments.en:
What is the penalty to be paid?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The deed is that of a Peshotanu: two hundred
stripes with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
罰則是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「此事屬於佩紹坦努罪：用馬鞭鞭打兩百下，用斯勞沙鞭鞭打兩百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ tashta ånguharena
ýaozhdayãn anghen ashâum ahura mazda ýâ
nasâum ava-bereta sûnô vâ para-iristahe
mashyehe vâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can the eating-vessels
be made clean that have been touched by Nasu from a dog, or Nasu
from a man?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些被納蘇——來自狗的納蘇或來自人的納蘇——所觸及的食器，是否能被淨化？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum zarathushtra, kva aêva, ýezi
anghat zarenaênish hakeret frasnâdhayen maêsmana
gêush hakeret zemô uzdâthayen hakeret âpô
frasnâdhayen atha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They can, O holy Zarathushtra!'
How so?
'If they be of gold, you shall wash them once with gomez, you
shall rub them once with earth, you shall wash them once with
water, and they shall be clean.
'If they be of silver, you shall wash them twice with gomez, you
shall rub them twice with earth, you shall wash them twice with
water, and they shall be clean.
[75. 'If they be of iron, you shall wash them thrice with gomez,
you shall rub them thrice with earth, you shall wash them thrice
with water, and they shall be clean.
'If they be of steel, you shall wash them four times with gomez,
you shall rub them four times with earth, you shall wash them
four times with water, and they shall be clean.
'If they be of stone, you shall wash them six times with gomez,
you shall rub them six times with earth, you shall wash them six
times with water, and they shall be clean.]
'If they be of earth, of wood, or of clay, they are unclean for
ever and ever.'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它們能夠被潔淨，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！」
怎樣潔淨？
「若它們是金製的，你應當用牛尿液洗它們一次，用泥土擦它們一次，用水洗它們一次，於是它們就潔淨了。
「若它們是銀製的，你應當用牛尿液洗它們兩次，用泥土擦它們兩次，用水洗它們兩次，於是它們就潔淨了。
〔75.「若它們是鐵製的，你應當用牛尿液洗它們三次，用泥土擦它們三次，用水洗它們三次，於是它們就潔淨了。
「若它們是鋼製的，你應當用牛尿液洗它們四次，用泥土擦它們四次，用水洗它們四次，於是它們就潔淨了。
「若它們是石製的，你應當用牛尿液洗它們六次，用泥土擦它們六次，用水洗它們六次，於是它們就潔淨了。〕
「若它們是泥土製、木製或陶製的，它們將永遠、永遠不潔。」

segments.orig:
âat ýezi anghat erezataênish bish frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush bish zemô uzdâthayen bish
âpô frasnâdhayen atha ýaozhdayãn,
âat ýezi anghat ayanghaênish thrish frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush thrish zemô uzdâthayen
thrish âpô frasnâdhayen atha ýaozhdayãn,
âat ýezi anghat haosafnaênish cathrush frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush cathrush zemô uzdâthayen
cathrush âpô frasnâdhayen atha ýaozhdayãn,
âat ýezi anghat zarshtvaênish xshvash frasnâdhayen
maêsmana gêush xshvash zemô uzdâthayen
xshvash âpô frasnâdhayen atha ýaozhdayãn,
âat ýezi anghat zemaênish drvaênish fravâxshaênish
ýavaêtâite ayaozhdya.

dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ gêush ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum ahura mazda ýâ nasâum franguharât
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can the cow
be made clean that has eaten of the carcass of a dog, or of the
corpse of a man?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！曾吃過狗屍或人屍的母牛，能被潔淨嗎？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum zarathushtra, nôit payô fshuta
zaothre nôit gêush zaothre baresmaine paiti-baire
añtarât naêmât ýâre-drâjô
âat pasca ýâre-drâjô vasô
hvarethå anghen nerebyô ashavabyô hamatha ýatha
paracit.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'She can, O holy Zarathushtra! The priest
shall not, within a year, take from her either milk or cheese
for the libation, nor meat for the libation and the Baresma. When
a year has passed, then the faithful may eat of her as before.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「她能被潔淨，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！祭司在一年內不應從她取奶或起司作奠禮，也不應取肉作奠禮和巴雷斯瑪。一年過後，信徒才可如先前一樣吃她的產物。」

segments.orig:
kô hô anghat ahura mazda ýô ashem
mainimnô ashem isemnô ashem aparaodhayeite ashemca
mainimnô drujimca vînasti.
segments.en:
Who is he, O holy Ahura Mazda! who, meaning well and desiring
righteousness, prevents righteousness? Who is he who, meaning
well, falls into the ways of the Druj?
segments.zh: 聖者阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，誰是那人，他懷有善意、渴望正道，卻妨礙正道？誰是那人，他懷有善意，卻陷入德魯格的途徑？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hô bâ
anghat ashâum zarathushtra ýô ashem mainimnô
ashem isemnô ashem aparaodhayeite ashemca mainimnô
drujimca vînasti ýô nasumaitîm âpem
vîzaothrãm frabaraiti ýô upa-naxturushu
tãthraêshu vîzaothrãm frabaraiti!
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'This one, meaning well and desiring
righteousness, prevents righteousness; this one, meaning well,
falls into the ways of the Druj, who offers up water defiled by
the dead and unfit for libation; or who offers up in the dead
of the night water unfit for libation.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「這就是那人，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊，他懷有善意、渴望正道，卻妨礙正道；他懷有善意，卻陷入德魯格的途徑——他奉獻被納蘇污染、不適用於奠禮的水；或者他在黑夜深處奉獻不適用於奠禮的水。」
